steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each stated SLA figure is matched to its rows, and each SLA to its definition.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 stated figure does not match its rows

findings.title: Stated figure does not match its rows
findings.fix: Correct the figure to the rows

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] sla-accuracy.csv:12  Stated figure does not match its rows.
       Fix: Correct the figure to the rows.
[medium] sla-definitions.md:19  SLA with no definition.
       Fix: Write the definition.
[low] monthly-claim.md:26  Figure with no source.
       Fix: Name the source.
Not checked: Client views outside the survey.
pros: Checks a stated figure that does not match its rows, and an SLA with no definition.
cons: Not checked: Client views outside the survey.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-hro-sla-report skill on the records for this review.
